objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use one of the bank's SQL injections to read the flag stored in the flags table of its database.
hints: The login form builds its query with string formatting, and so does a balance lookup that takes an account number in the URL.
The balance lookup prints the columns it selects: rows from another table can ride along.

steps.title: Find the endpoint
steps.prompt: Which URL path checks an account's balance from an account number in the path? (its first segment)

steps.title: Identify the database
steps.prompt: Which database server does the bank use? (name only)

steps.title: Pick the technique
steps.prompt: Which SQL operator appends rows from another table to the lookup's result?

steps.title: Enumerate the tables
steps.prompt: Which standard schema lists the tables of the database, including flags?
